4 MB: plus an otadata region recording which of the two the

# penguinOS: # bootloader should pick - so a 4 MB part has to carry the app twice and there

# THE ARITHMETIC
4 MB: because every field here is the consequence of another:

# penguinOS: #   bootloader              0x0000 .. 0x9000    the first free offset is 0x9000
#   nvs        24 KB        Wi-Fi credentials
#   phy_init    4 KB        radio calibration
#   otadata     8 KB        which slot boots. TWO 4 KB sectors
#                           bootloader writes them alternately so a power cut
#                           during a switch leaves the other one intact.
#   ota_0    1
#   ota_1    1
#   int        640 KB       LittleFS: themes

4 MB: 096 KB exactly. There is no slack.

# penguinOS: # App partitions must start on a 64 KB boundary
4 MB: which is why ota_0 begins at

# penguinOS: # 0x20000 and not immediately after otadata
4 MB: and why the slot size is a multiple
664 KB against an image of about 1
490 KB leaves roughly 174 KB - a little

4 MB: and a build that overflows a

# penguinOS: # slot says so at link time rather than at update time.
# int WENT FROM 960 KB TO 640 KB and MOVED from 0x310000 to 0x360000. Moving it

# was on the filesystem: the data is still in the flash
# looks at any more. Boards keep their nvs - the flasher does not rewrite a
# stamp that is already correct - so Wi-Fi credentials and names survive.
